[[File:Abyssal beast icon.png|left]]
'''Abyssal beasts''' are a type of [[demon]] players can find in the [[Senntisten Asylum]] and the [[Wilderness]]. They are the second strongest of the [[Abyssal Slayer creatures]]. They require a [[Slayer]] level of 105 in order to be harmed. 

They are best known for their [[Jaws of the Abyss]] drop, a tier 85 melee headgear that capitalises on bleed damage and their high drop rate of [[Sealed clue scroll (elite)|elite clue scrolls]] compared to other monsters.

When killed on an [[Abyssal demons (Slayer assignment)|abyssal demons task]] or a [[Demons (Slayer assignment)|demon cluster task]], each kill reduces the count by 2.

Alongside possessing the ability to teleport around like [[abyssal demon]]s, the abyssal beast will periodically lash its tongue out (far longer and wider than their auto-attack) in a targeted area; if the player does not move from it, they will take moderate melee damage and the beast will heal for the damage the attack would have dealt.

==Trivia==
* The [[abyssal savage]], abyssal beast, and [[abyssal lord]] were designed by [[Mod Shogun]] during [[Game Jam]] 2017 and 2018. They were called [[abyssal hound]]s during development as shown with the concept art.
* While attack damage from abyssal beasts are not reduced by [[Deflect Curses|protect/deflect prayers]], they are reduced by [[Power of Light]], the [[Weapon Special Attack]] of a [[staff of light]].
